picks.title: Scaler EQ Pro Announced With Note-Aware EQ And MIDI-Controlled Live Mode
picks.excerpt: Scaler EQ Pro detects a track's key automatically and boosts frequencies inside that key while cutting the ones outside it. Adds MIDI-controlled Live Mode, dynamic EQ with sidechain, mid/side and zero latency. $99, ships 23 September 2026.
picks.rationale: EQ that listens to the key of the track — a mixing decision a producer makes every session, now automated.

picks.title: Initial D artist MOTSU releases FREE zero-latency vocal tuner MotTune MIDI
picks.excerpt: MOTSU of m.o.v.e and DeeJei.Tokyo released MotTune MIDI, a free real-time pitch correction and vocoder plugin with a zero-latency live mode driven from MIDI. The companion iPhone app separates vocals from songs on-device.
picks.rationale: Free, no-account vocal tuning with a live zero-latency mode plus on-device stem separation — immediately usable.

picks.title: Is AI Slop Giving Artists and Creators a New Life?
picks.excerpt: Fiverr data shows demand for human music trades climbing as AI output floods the market: topline writing up 466%, songwriting up 426%, strings up 116%. Olivia Rodrigo's handmade lyric-video commission became news on its own.
picks.rationale: Hard numbers on the counter-move: as AI output saturates, hiring humans becomes the visible signal.

picks.title: Sonos CEO explains how 'Custom Agents' will work for listeners
picks.excerpt: Sonos CEO Tom Conrad described Custom Agents: listeners pick an inference engine (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok), give it a voice, a name and a personality, then run several at once for recommendations or live-music discovery.
picks.rationale: Discovery moves from playlist to persona — the listening surface itself becomes a designed character.

picks.title: klattsch Turns 1980s Speech Synthesis Into A Singing Instrument
picks.excerpt: Crash United's klattsch rebuilds Dennis Klatt's 1980 formant synthesizer as a playable singing instrument, with a piano roll, phoneme assignment and hand-drawn pitch curves. Free in the browser, $9.99 on desktop and Android.
picks.rationale: A deliberately non-neural counterpoint to AI vocal models: every synthesis parameter exposed and editable.
